title: Am I the only one?
content: I have a horrendous sleep schedule, ( I know this is extremely unhealthy and I am trying to fix it ) I mostly sleep between 2 to to maybe at most 3 hours every night for 5 days of the week, which means I am sleep deprived when I am like this and finally get some proper sleep 8 times out of 10 would dream about our place Mallworld these dreams would be long lasting sometimes it’s just me walking in a single lane highway that is floating up in the air or I’d be in the beach surrounded by familiar yet unknown people ( I will try to draw these things that I have seen and will try my best with these drawings bc my drawing skill is basically nonexistent ). ( Once again I am not Rp or writing this to get any kind of clout or attention i am genuinely asking )
